announcements.text: Apogee Engineering LLC, Colorado Springs, Colorado (FA8604-26-D-B003); KBR Wyle Services LLC, Chantilly, Virginia (FA8604-26-D-B009); Riverside Research Institute, Fairfax, Virginia (FA8604-26-D-B005); and Systems Planning and Analysis Inc., Alexandria, Virginia (FA8604-26-D-B006), were awarded an $866,000,000 ceiling, multiple-award, indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity contract for advisory and assistance services. This contract provides for advisory and assistance services for the National Air and Space Intelligence Center. Work will be performed at Dayton, Ohio, and is expected to be completed by June 30, 2034. These contracts were the result of a competitive acquisition, and four offers were received. Fiscal 2026 operations and maintenance funds in the amount of $20,000 are being obligated at the time of award. The Air Force Life Cycle Management Center, Wright-Patterson Air Force Base, Ohio, is the contracting activity.

The Boeing Co., Tukwila, Washington, has been awarded a maximum $125,000,000 modification (P00176) to a previously awarded contract (FA8625-16-C-6599) for the procurement of initial long lead spare parts for two, fully mission capable, VC-25B aircraft. The modification brings the total cumulative face value of the contract to $ 4,445,303,996 from $4,320,303,996. Work will be performed at San Antonio, Texas. Fiscal 2026 research, development, test, and evaluation funds in the amount of $41,925,000 are being obligated at the time of award. The Air Force Life Cycle Management Center, Wright Patterson Air Force Base, Ohio, is the contracting activity.

General Dynamics Mission Systems Inc., Scottsdale, Arizona, has been awarded a maximum ceiling $69,702,627 requirements, indefinite-delivery contract for the KIV-78A. This contract provides for the production of the KIV-78A and circuit card assemblies. Work will be performed at Scottsdale, Arizona, and is expected to be completed by May 5, 2031. This contract involves Foreign Military Sales to Australia, Belgium, Canada, Germany, Isreal, Italy, Japan, Korea, Kuwait, Netherlands, Norway, Poland, Turkey, Saudi Arabia, Switzerland, the United Arab Emirates, the United Kingdom, and more. This contract was a sole source acquisition. Fiscal 2026 procurement funds in the amount of $8,269,381 are being obligated on the first delivery order after contract award. The Air Force Life Cycle Management Center, Cryptologic and Cyber Systems Division, San Antonio, Texas, is the contracting activity (FA830726DB002).

General Electric Co., Lynn, Massachusetts, has been awarded an estimated $51,542,494 delivery order (SPE4AX-24-F-3871) issued against a six-year one-month base contract (SPE4AX-20-D-9002) with one two-year seven-month and one one-year nine-month option periods for additional lot payments to Performance Period Four for TF34 engine supplies. This was a sole-source acquisition using justification 10 U.S. Code 3204 (a)(1), as stated in Federal Acquisition Regulation 6.302-1. This is a one-year contract with no option periods. The performance completion date is Dec. 31, 2024. The using military services are Air Force and Navy. Type of appropriation is fiscal 2024 through 2025 defense appropriated funds and defense working capital funds. The contracting activity is Defense Logistics Agency Weapons Support, Richmond, Virginia. (Awarded on Dec. 19, 2023).

General Electric Co., Lynn, Massachusetts, has been awarded an estimated $26,990,236 delivery order (SPE4AX-25-F-1284) issued against a six-year one-month base contract (SPE4AX-20-D-9002) with one two-year seven-month and one one-year nine-month option periods for additional lot payments to Performance Period 5 for TF34 engine supplies. This was a sole-source acquisition using justification 10 U.S. code 3204 (a)(1), as stated in Federal Acquisition Regulation 6.302-1. This is a one-year contract with no option periods. The performance completion date is May 31, 2026. Using military services are Air Force and Navy. Type of appropriation is fiscal 2025 through 2026 defense appropriated funds and defense working capital funds. The contracting activity is Defense Logistics Agency Weapons Support, Richmond, Virginia. (Awarded on Dec. 13, 2024).

Thales Defense & Security Inc., Clarksburg, Maryland, has been awarded a maximum $15,889,911 firm-fixed-price contract for H-60 aircraft sonar dome depot level repairable spares. This was a sole-source acquisition using justification 10 U.S. Code 3204 (a)(1), as stated by Federal Acquisition Regulation 6.302-1. This is a three-year seven-month contract with no option periods. Locations of performance are France and Maryland, with a performance completion date of Dec. 17, 2029. The using customers are Foreign Military Sales South Korea and Spain. The type of appropriation is fiscal 2026 foreign military sales funding. The contracting activity is Defense Logistics Agency Weapons Support, Philadelphia, Pennsylvania (SPRPA1-26-C-RA24).

UPDATE: USVetServ LLC,* Simpsonville, South Carolina (SPE2D1-26-D-0010, $36,180,000), has been added as an awardee to the multiple award contract for medical equipment and accessories for the Defense Logistics Agency Electronic Catalog, issued against solicitation SPE2DH-21-R-0002 and awarded Feb. 10, 2022. The contracting activity is Defense Logistics Agency Troop Support, Philadelphia, Pennsylvania.

San Diego Gas and Electric Co., San Diego, California, is awarded a $51,244,157 firm-fixed-price task order (N62473-21-G-4402/N6247326F0173) for utility energy conservation. This task order provides for energy conservation and resiliency projects comprised of various energy conservation measures affecting multiple facilities across Marine Corps Base Camp Pendleton. Work will be performed at Oceanside, California, and is expected to be completed by May 2031. No funds will be obligated at the time of award. This project will utilize third party financing through the utility company and will not expire at the end of the current fiscal year. This contract was not competitively procured and solicited as a sole source. The Naval Facilities Engineering Systems Command, Southwest, San Diego, California, is the contracting activity.

Parker Hannifin Corp., Irvine, California, is awarded a $17,799,177 firm-fixed-price delivery order (N00383-26-F-BN0C) under a previously awarded basic ordering agreement (N00383-24-G-BN01) for the overhaul of 443 hydraulic horizontal stabilator servo cylinders used on the F18 E/F aircraft. Work will be performed in Irvine, California (75%); and San Diego, California (25%). All work is expected to be completed by October 2028. Fiscal 2026 working capital funds (Navy) in the contract’s full amount of $17,799,177 will be obligated at time of award and those funds will not expire at the end of the applicable fiscal year. One company was solicited for this sole-source requirement pursuant to the authority set forth in 10 U.S. Code 3204(a)(1), with one offer received. Naval Supply Systems Command Weapon Systems Support, Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, is the contracting activity.

Nikira Labs Inc.,* Mountain View, California, is awarded an $11,091,577 cost-plus-fixed-fee, firm-fixed-price, and cost only modification to a previously awarded contract (N00024-25-C-4303) to exercise options for continued development, production, and installation for the Spectroscopic Total Air Monitor. Work will be performed in Mountain View, California, and is expected to be completed by April 2030. Fiscal 2023 shipbuilding and conversion (Navy) funds in the amount of $1,713,000 will be obligated at the time of award and will not expire at the end of the current fiscal year. Naval Sea Systems Command, Washington, D.C., is the contracting activity.
